SELECT f.contract_no,f.company_id,f.company_name,f.department_id,f.department_code,f.department_name FROM () f
WHERE f.contract_no IN #{number} WHERE 1=0

SELECT c.contract_no FROM com_contract c JOIN (SELECT contract_no FROM com_contract WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND deleted = 0
GROUP BY contract_no HAVING COUNT(*) = 1) unique_number ON unique_number.contract_no = c.contract_no WHERE c.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.contract_no IS NOT NULL AND c.contract_no <> '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM com_shipment_contract_reference shipment WHERE shipment.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND shipment.deleted=0 AND shipment.contract_no=c.contract_no AND (shipment.company_code IS NULL OR shipment.company_code='' OR CAST(shipment.company_code AS BINARY) <> CAST(c.company_code AS BINARY)))
AND (
CAST(c.company_code AS BINARY) IN CAST(#{companyCode} AS BINARY)
OR
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM com_project_contract_relation pcr WHERE pcr.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND pcr.contract_id = c.id AND pcr.deleted = 0 AND pcr.status = 'ACTIVE' AND pcr.effective_to IS NULL AND pcr.project_id IN #{projectId})
)
AND 1 = 0

SELECT c.* FROM com_contract c WHERE c.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND c.id = #{query.contractId} AND c.deleted = 0 AND (
CAST(c.company_code AS BINARY) IN CAST(#{companyCode} AS BINARY)
OR
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM com_project_contract_relation pcr WHERE pcr.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND pcr.contract_id = c.id AND pcr.deleted = 0 AND pcr.status = 'ACTIVE' AND pcr.effective_to IS NULL AND pcr.project_id IN #{projectId})
) LIMIT 1
